item.title: Iran's Guards say they targeted a US early-warning radar in Bahrain
item.description:
Nov 13 (Reuters) - Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Friday they targeted a US early-warning radar in Bahrain, the first such claim of an attack on American military assets in a Gulf country since early September.

The Guards said the strike was in retaliation for what they described as an air attack on a telecommunications tower in Iran's southern Sirik county, in Hormozgan province, according to Iranian state media.

item.title: Publication of air crash probes falls short, safety advocates say
item.description:
By Allison Lampert

MONTREAL, Nov 12 (Reuters) - National agencies around the world have not published enough air accident reports to generate recommendations that could improve safety for the flying public, advocates said on the sidelines of an industry conference on Thursday.

Final reports are published for only about half of all aviation accidents that are investigated under international rules, despite calls by airline trade groups to improve those results, said an executive with one such group, IATA.

item.title: Australia and Jordan shift match from Amman over security worries
item.description:
Australia and Jordan on Friday agreed to move their upcoming friendly from Amman to Doha after players voiced concerns about security.

The Socceroos are scheduled to face Qatar in Doha on Friday and were then set to meet Jordan four days later in Amman.

But after Australian players expressed worries about travelling to Jordan given tensions in the Mideast, the second match has been relocated.

item.title: Pro-Palestinian group seeks ban on Israeli real-estate fair in Paris
item.description:
Pro-Palestinian activists have asked a French court to ban an Israeli real-estate fair in Paris which they say offers a bonus to prospective Jewish settlers in the occupied territories, sources told AFP on Thursday.

The Franco-Palestinian NIDAL association filed an emergency motion to a court against the 9th Icube real estate and investment salon, arguing that the fair violates human rights.

The event is to place on Sunday at the European Centre for Judaism in the French capital.

item.title: US House Democratic Leader Jeffries wants 'dramatic change' in Middle East
item.description:
By Patricia Zengerle

WASHINGTON, Nov 12 (Reuters) - US House of Representatives Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called on Thursday for "dramatic change" in the Middle East and reiterated his support for a two-state solution for Israel and the Palestinians.

Democrats' sweeping victories in last week's midterm elections could lead to the curbing of US support for its close ally Israel, putting the spotlight on party leaders'views as they prepare to take control of both houses of Congress on January 3.

item.title: Saudi Arabia puts pressure on EU to label Yemen's Houthis a terrorist group
item.description:
By Alexander Cornwell

Nov 12 (Reuters) - Saudi Arabia is pressing the EU to designate Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement as a terrorist organisation, but has yet to overcome European concerns that this could undermine a future peace process, according to six European officials.

The campaign reflects a broader effort by Riyadh to increase international pressure on the group, which has been carrying out near-daily attacks on the kingdom in recent weeks after the resumption of war that began more than a decade ago.
